notes: Correcoes: botoes "Gerir addons"/"Ir as Definicoes" no leitor ja nao deixam a app presa num ecra em branco nem travam. Fontes: filtro de idioma passou a incluir Latino/MX, Frances, Alemao, Italiano e Russo. Popup de avaliacao do episodio ja nao aparece a meio quando o download da fonte estagna.
notesEn: Fixes: "Manage addons"/"Go to Settings" buttons in the player no longer leave the app stuck on a blank screen or freeze. Sources: language filter now includes Latin American Spanish, French, German, Italian and Russian. The episode rating popup no longer appears mid-episode when the source's download stalls.
